source: CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, 2025 CRD, §7.2.3.2 Repeat-to-fill and §11 track sizing; independently derived before Chromium observation

repeatCountBoundary.derivation: Two repetitions contain four minimum track sizes totaling 140px and three 10px gutters, totaling 170px. One repetition needs 70px of track minima and one 10px gutter, totaling 80px.

notes: auto-fill retains all repeated tracks even when unoccupied.
auto-fit retains the repeat count, then collapses unoccupied repeated tracks and gutters adjoining collapsed tracks after auto-placement.
The hidden child is not a grid item and does not occupy a repeated track.
The overflow child keeps its 240px used width; the grid container does not clip or clamp it.
